name: Tough
description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your Hit Point maximum increases by an additional 2 Hit Points.

name: Alert
description: You gain a bonus to Initiative equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can also swap Initiative with a willing ally (provided neither of you is Incapacitated).

name: Lucky
description: You have a number of Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Spend a Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on a d20 Test, or to impose Disadvantage on an attack roll against you. You regain your expended Luck Points on a Long Rest.

name: Savage Attacker
description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll.

name: Skilled
description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
description: You learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from the Wizard spell list. You can cast the level 1 spell once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots if you have them). Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
description: You learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list. You can cast the level 1 spell once per Long Rest without a slot. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Healer
description: You can use a Healer's Kit to restore Hit Points (1d6 + 4 + the creature's number of Hit Dice) to a creature, once per creature per Short or Long Rest. You also have battle-tested precision.

name: Crafter
description: You gain proficiency with three Artisan's Tools of your choice, get a 20% discount on nonmagical items, and can craft faster during downtime.

name: Musician
description: You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments. After a Short or Long Rest, you can play to grant Heroic Inspiration to allies equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: Your Unarmed Strike damage die is 1d4, you can reroll a 1 on it once per turn, you gain proficiency with improvised weapons, and you can push a target 5 feet when you hit with an Unarmed Strike.
